title: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE
RESEARCH
COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CXXVII OF
2002
Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Space and
Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981 (XX of 1981)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 1, 15th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
15-11-2002.-----The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Space and
Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Substitution of section 2, Ordinance XX of 1981

PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE
RESEARCH
COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CXXVII OF
2002
Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Space and
Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981 (XX of 1981)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 1, 15th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
15-11-2002.-----The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information.
2. Substitution of section 2,
Ordinance XX of 1981.---In the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research
Commission Ordinance, 1981 (XX of 1981), hereinafter referred as the said
Ordinance, for section 2 the following shall be substituted, namely:-
2. Definition.---In
this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or
context,----
(a)
"Chairman" means the Chairman of the Commission;
(b)
"CJCSC" means the Chairman Joints Chiefs of Staff Committee;
(c)
"Commission" means the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research
Commission (SUPARCO);
(d)
"DCC" means the Development Control Committee of NCA;
(e) 'NCA"
means, the National Command Authority;
(f)
"prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance;.
(g)
"Secretary" means the Secretary of the Commission; and
(h)
"SPD" means Strategic Plans Division, Joint Staff. Headquarters.
".

[Gazette of Pakistan,

F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated

7. Amendment of section 7;
Ordinance XX of 1981.---In the said Ordinance, in section 7,-
(a) for subsection (1) the
following shall be substituted; namely:-
".(1) The
Federal Government shall .establish, in accordance with the provisions of this
Ordinance, a Commission to be called the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere
Research Commission.";
(b) for
subsection (3) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(3) Every employment' under
the Commission shall, for the purpose of the Pakistan Essential Services
(Maintenance) Act, 1952 (LIII of 1952), be deemed to be employment under the-
Federal Government and the said Act shall have effect accordingly. "; and
(c) for subsection (4) the
following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(4) The Federal Government
shall exercise control over the commission through DCC of NCA. SPD being-the
secretariat of NCA shall coordinate tasking and exercise financial and
administrative control over the Commission.".

15-11-2002.-----The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information.
8. Substitution of section 8,
Ordinance XX of 1981.----In the said Ordinance for section 8 the following
shall be substituted; namely:-
"8.
Composition of the Commission.---(1) The Commission shall consist of the
following members. namely:-
(a) Chairman;
(b) Member,
Space Technology;
(c) Member;'
Space Electronics;
(d) Member,
Space Research;'
(e) Member,
Range; and
(t) Member,
Finance.
(2) The Chairman
of the Commission shall be appointed by the President on the recommendation of
the CJCSC.
(3) The
President may, on recommendation of the CJCSC, increase or decrease the number
of members of the Commission.
(2) The members
of the Commission shall be appointed by the President on the recommendation of
CJCSC.".

9. Amendment of section 9
Ordinance XX of 1981.,---In the said Ordinance in section 9,-
(a) for clause (a) the following
shall be substituted, namely:-
"(a) to advance research and
development in space science and allied fields and to enhance indigenous
capabilities in space technology and 'to promote the peaceful applications of
space science and technology for the socioe-conomic development of the
country;';
(b) in clause (b), for the words
"Council" the letters "DCC" shall be substituted;
(c) in clause (c), for the, words
"Executive Committee" the letters "DCC" shall be substituted;
(d) in clause (d), for the words
"Executive Committee" the letters "DCC" shall be
substituted; and
(e) for clause (e) the following
shall be substituted, namely:-
"(e) to do all acts and
things including research and development projects in space science and
technology for the execution of policies laid down by the DCC.".
